title: Dotbee Configuration Schema
description: Configuration schema for Dotbee dotfiles manager

on_conflict.description: How to handle conflicts. Options: 'overwrite', 'adopt', 'skip', 'abort', 'ask'. Default: 'ask' (interactive).

enumValues: Overwrite the existing file with the symlink
Adopt the existing file into your dotfiles (moves it to the source path)
Ask the user what to do (default)

vars.description: User-defined variables usable in link src/dst paths via {name} interpolation. Values are plain strings and are not themselves interpolated.

profiles.description: Named profiles containing specific configurations. 'global' is a reserved profile name for links applied regardless of the active profile.

links.description: Symlinks to create for this profile. Each entry is a named link: { 'name': { 'src': 'source', 'dst': 'destination' } }

additionalProperties.description: A single link with a source and destination path

src.description: Path to the source file/dir inside the dotfiles repo. May reference variables from [vars] as {name}.

dst.description: Destination path for the symlink (e.g. ~/.config/foo). May reference variables from [vars] as {name}.
